name: haunted-gallery
description: Haunted Gallery: PlayCanvas phone client + authoritative Colyseus server. Root build for Colyseus Cloud.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix server run build
